question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Rare
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1 i.e. (**Familiar**)'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Rare**" refers to something not occurring very often or something that is not frequently encountered.(**दुर्लभ**)
 
• The word "**Familiar**" refers to something well known from long or close association. (**परिचित**)
 
• It is opposite in meaning to the word '**Rare'**. 

Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Familiar'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Latent**" (अदृश्य) refers to something existing but not yet developed or manifest; hidden or concealed.
 
• "**Clarify**" (स्पष्ट करना) means to make a statement or situation less confused and more comprehensible.
 
• "**Extraordinary**" (असाधारण) means very unusual or remarkable.
